mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM agri_md_product p LEFT JOIN agri_md_product_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.del_flag = 0
SELECT * FROM agri_md_product WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT p.id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.brand, p.unit, p.origin, p.spec_json, p.price, p.image_urls, p.status, p.tenant_id, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.remark, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM agri_md_product p LEFT JOIN agri_md_product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
